svg.aria-label: How ICuCrops works: sensors send readings to the ESP32 boards, which pass them over MQTT to the Raspberry Pi 4 running ICuCrops. The Pi switches the equipment through the ESP32 boards, syncs with Supabase for the online dashboard, and keeps an offline database in SQLite for the kiosk, which shows both the offline and the online dashboard.
